text:
karen-customer: Hey @support, overnight we started seeing a lot of 503s from /v1/generate and when responses do come back they're truncated (missing code blocks) and shorter. Also noticed a spike in token billing. Our app was targeting eu-west-1 but the server logs show requests routed to us-east-2. Request id: rq_01F9a2b3. Can you help?

maria-support: sorry to hear that — can you paste the request id + exact timestamp? did you set any region headers (X-Client-Region / X-RW-Force-Region)?

karen-customer: req=rq_01F9a2b3, client ts=2410998800, server saw failover at 2410998823. We don't set X-RW-Force-Region, rely on auto routing. Example curl we use attached: 

karen-customer: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-l7-1.2","input":"Write a python function to parse CSV into dicts, include docstring and basic tests"}'
```

devon-eng: @maria-support I pulled the trace for rq_01F9a2b3. Routing log shows origin eu-west-1 but health probe failed during token 1k burst. Routing policy fell back to the standby pool in us-east-2 which serves a different variant: `redwood-lite-v1-q4_0` (quantized lite). That variant uses a trimmed tokenizer/vocab and has smaller context and different chunking, which explains both truncated code blocks and different token counts. :facepalm:

sanjay-sre: adding telemetry: eu-west-1 pod pool exhausted, autoscaler lag ~18s on the burst. The fallback path is currently allowing cross-family fallbacks (L7 -> Lite) for availability — that's the real root cause. 503s came from connection queue timeouts while the policy switched routes.

maria-support: @karen-customer short-term we can: 1) pin your org to prefer eu-west-1 (avoid auto cross-region failover), 2) pin model_version to `redwood-l7-1.2@v123` so the system won't swap to a lite family, or 3) set header `X-RW-Force-Region: eu-west-1` in your requests. Which do you want us to apply?

karen-customer: Please pin org to eu-west-1 and pin model_version; header change will require some deploys on our side. Also we need billing clarity — tokens billed are higher despite shorter outputs.

devon-eng: token accounting explanation: different tokenizer -> different tokenization granularity. Also our fallback path currently records attempt metrics for both primary + fallback attempts in rare cases (we bill the tail attempt). We're going to open an internal billing review and provisional credit this incident until we reconcile. tagging @billing-bot.

billing-bot: Billing alert created: BILL-INC-5634, provisional credit pending review.

maria-support: To help engineering debug, can you reproduce and paste both the request/response payloads (full) and the X-RW-Request-Id header from your client logs? If you can't share full payloads here, DM and I'll provide a secure upload link.

karen-customer: pasted sanitized responses. Original expected (when served by l7): 

karen-customer: ```
# expected (redwood-l7-1.2@v123)
def parse_csv(s: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
    """Parse CSV and return list of dicts.
    ...
    """
    # implementation...

# basic tests
```

karen-customer: ```
# fallback response (redwood-lite-v1-q4_0)
def parse_csv(s):
    # truncated, missing tests and docstring
    pass
```

devon-eng: that makes sense — lite variant drops docstrings and loses some tokens due to different vocab mapping. Repro recipe for us (internal): 

maria-support: repro steps (public-safe): 
```
# 1) send regular request to eu endpoint without region pin
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-l7-1.2","input":"<long prompt that uses codeblock>", "client_timestamp":2410998800}'

# 2) Simulate eu region capacity drop by toggling header used by our test harness: X-RW-Simulate-Region-Drain: eu-west-1 (internal)
# 3) Observe routing log: fallback to standby pool -> check variant header X-RW-Served-Model
```

sanjay-sre: action items: 
- (P0) short-term: pin this org to eu-west-1 and pin model_version for customer's calls (maria-support)
- (P1) runtime: change fallback policy to prefer same family variants or region-local variants (devon-eng)
- (P1) autoscaler tuning: reduce cold-start lag for eu-west-1 (sanjay-sre)
- (P2) billing: review dual-attempt billing for these failover cases and issue provisional credit (billing-bot)

maria-support: applied org pin + pinned model_version for karen-customer org — please verify and report any more failures.

karen-customer: verified after pin — responses restored and codeblocks back. Thanks. Can you confirm timeline and when billing credit shows up?

billing-bot: Provisional credit applied to account KAREN-ORG for incident BILL-INC-5634. Final reconciliation pending review, will update in 48h.

devon-eng: follow-ups: we'll open INF-2411 to change fallback selection logic to avoid cross-architecture/model-family swaps. Also adding a router metric to count family-mismatch fallbacks so we can alert earlier.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2411 created and linked to ticket INF-2411 and BILL-INC-5634.

maria-support: closing this thread for now since pin fixed customer's immediate issue. Reopen if you see any more anomalies. :white_check_mark:
